role: Main-actor singleton that orders cold-launch background jobs: interactive-phase jobs run right away, housekeeping-phase jobs wait until the dashboard's first data load (or a 6 s ceiling), and at most 2 jobs run concurrently.
types: LaunchCoordinator: final class (@MainActor) — phase gate + concurrency limiter for launch jobs
toplevel: Callers: AppLaunchTasks.scheduleLaunchHousekeeping calls begin() (AppLaunchTasks.swift:406) then run(...) for migration/training/sync jobs (AppLaunchTasks.swift:428,481,523,557); MainTabView.applyDashboardLoad calls signalDashboardReady (MainTabView+Tabs.swift:126).

flags.text: No test in EmuquTests references LaunchCoordinator; the 6 s ceiling, the housekeeping gate and the slot limiter (whose earlier task-group version is documented as having hung housekeeping forever, LaunchCoordinator.swift:63-67) have no coverage.

units.does: Private initializer for the singleton; no work.
Once only: spawns a main-actor Task that waits for dashboard-ready or the 6 s ceiling, then opens the housekeeping gate and resumes every parked housekeeping waiter.

branches.effect: return (idempotent); false: set it and start the gate task

units.does: Marks the dashboard ready and resumes the parked ready-waiter, if any. Idempotent.

branches.effect: return; false: set true, resume and clear dashboardReadyWaiter

units.does: Returns when the dashboard signals ready or after 6 s, whichever first: starts a ceiling task that sleeps 6 s then releases the waiter, parks on the ready continuation, then cancels the ceiling.

branches.effect: return immediately; false: start ceiling and park

branches.cond: ceiling task was cancelled (ready arrived first)
branches.effect: return without releasing; not cancelled after 6 s: releaseDashboardWaiter()

units.does: Resumes and clears the parked dashboard-ready waiter without setting dashboardReady (timeout path).
Parks on a checked continuation stored in dashboardReadyWaiter, resuming at once if already ready.

branches.effect: true: resume immediately; false: store continuation for signalDashboardReady/releaseDashboardWaiter

units.does: Schedules a launch job on a detached task at the given priority that goes through runCoordinated; skipped entirely when skipInLowPower and lowPower are both true.

branches.effect: return without scheduling (job dropped for this launch); otherwise Task.detached runs it

units.does: Static: for housekeeping jobs waits for the gate, then acquires a concurrency slot, runs the work, and releases the slot — each step on AppDependencies.current.app.launchCoordinator.
calls: closure:work — job closure passed to run() by AppLaunchTasks (archive migrations, training rebuild, iCloud sync, etc.)

branches.effect: await awaitHousekeepingOpen() first; interactive: go straight to slot acquisition

units.does: Waits until the housekeeping gate opens (begin()'s task resumes the stored continuations).

branches.effect: true: resume at once; false: append to housekeepingWaiters

units.does: Takes a free slot at once (inFlight += 1) when inFlight < 2; otherwise parks once on a continuation appended to slotWaiters and returns when releaseSlot hands it the finishing job's slot (inFlight unchanged), so parked jobs start in arrival order.

branches.effect: true: inFlight += 1 and return; false: append continuation to slotWaiters and wait to be handed a slot

units.does: Hands the finishing job's slot straight to the oldest waiter (removes and resumes it, inFlight unchanged); with no waiter, frees the slot (inFlight -= 1).

branches.effect: true: inFlight -= 1; false: remove and resume the first waiter, which now owns the slot
